title: Luxury Bangkok and Pattaya Escape
alt: Lit up temples along the Chao Phraya river in Bangkok at dusk
transport: Private sedan transfers with shared tour coaches

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Four nights, two five star hotels and no long drives. This is the easy luxury version of a first Thailand trip.
expert.tip: Ask for a high floor at the Royal Cliff so you get the bay from your balcony. On the cruise day, eat light at lunch because the buffet on board is generous.

summary: A short luxury run through Thailand with two nights in Bangkok and two on the Pattaya coast. Safari World, a Chao Phraya dinner cruise, the Alcazar cabaret and a speedboat day on Coral Island, with five star hotels throughout.
included: Included: 4 nights in 2 five star hotels with daily breakfast; Safari World and Marine Park tickets; Chao Phraya river dinner cruise; Alcazar cabaret standard seats; Coral Island speedboat tour from Pattaya; 11 airport, intercity and sightseeing transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; water sports and personal expenses; lunches and dinners other than the cruise dinner.

day_titles.2: Safari World and a river dinner cruise
day_titles.3: On to Pattaya and the Alcazar show

1: Arrival at Suvarnabhumi Airport and private sedan transfer to your Bangkok hotel
Check in at the Hyatt Regency on Sukhumvit and take the evening slowly
Nana Skytrain station is a minute away if you want to wander
Optional: Erawan Museum, the floating market or Siam Park City
2: Breakfast at the hotel, then shared transfer out to Safari World
Open safari loop past zebras, giraffes and big cats in the morning
Marine Park shows after lunch, then back into the city
Evening shared transfer to the Chao Phraya river dinner cruise
Buffet dinner on board with live music and lit up temples on the banks
3: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer down to Pattaya
Check in at the Royal Cliff, set on its own headland above the bay
Afternoon free for the pool terraces and the private beach
Evening shared transfer to the Alcazar cabaret with standard seats
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Bali Hai pier
Speedboat transfer across to Coral Island for the day
Swim and sunbathe at Tawaen beach, water sports payable on the sand
Return speedboat and shared transfer to your Pattaya hotel
5: Breakfast and a slow check out at your own pace
Private sedan transfer to Suvarnabhumi Airport for your trip home

stops.name: Bangkok
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · 5★ · On Sukhumvit beside Nana Skytrain, with a rooftop pool

program.name: City nights and Safari World
program.description: Two nights on Sukhumvit with an open safari park by day and a buffet dinner cruise down the Chao Phraya after dark.

activities.name: Safari World and Marine Park
activities.description: An open safari loop with zebras, giraffes and big cats, then dolphin and sea lion shows at Marine Park next door.

activities.name: Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Two hours on the river with a buffet dinner, live music and lit up views of Wat Arun and the Grand Palace from the water.

activities.name: Erawan Museum
activities.description: A three headed elephant in bronze above a hall of stained glass and gardens. An easy half day on your free first evening.

activities.name: Floating Market
activities.description: Narrow canals, boats loaded with fruit and noodles cooked over charcoal at the water. Best early in the day.

stops.name: Pattaya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · 5★ · On the Royal Cliff headland with private beach and pool terraces

program.name: Beach days and cabaret lights
program.description: Two nights on the Pattaya coast with the Alcazar cabaret in the evening and a speedboat day out to Coral Island.

activities.name: Alcazar Cabaret Show
activities.description: Pattaya's long running cabaret, an hour of costumes, live singing and big stage sets with standard seating included.

activities.name: Coral Island by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day out to Koh Larn with clear water at Tawaen beach, sun loungers on the sand and water sports if you want them.
